description: Audit a cold email campaign before launch: the lead CSV and the sequence checked together for merge tags with no column or empty values, variable syntax the sequencer will not parse, role and disposable addresses, duplicates and too many contacts per company, plus a send forecast from the sending settings. Pass the CSV text and every step of the sequence.

csv.description: The lead CSV as text, header row first.

daysPerWeek.description: Sending days a week. Defaults to 5.

maxPerCompany.description: Contacts allowed per company domain. Defaults to 2.

perInbox.description: Sends per inbox per day. Defaults to 30.

sequence.description: Every step of the sequence, merge tags as written, e.g. {{first_name}}.

name: audit_campaign
title: Pre-send campaign audit
